title: Stripe-style payment webhook: fulfill each paid order exactly once
contract: One paid order leads to exactly one fulfillment, even when the webhook is delivered more than once, concurrently, or under a different event ID; a failed fulfillment is never marked complete.
interface: export async function handleWebhook(event, deps) -> Promise<{ ok: boolean, action: "fulfilled" | "duplicate" | "ignored" }>; deps = { fulfillOrder: async (orderId: string) => void } (may throw)

cases.title: Same event delivered 20 times concurrently fulfills the order once
Different event IDs for the same payment/order fulfill it once
Unknown event types are acknowledged and ignored
Two different orders are each fulfilled exactly once
Failed fulfillment is not marked complete; retry fulfills exactly once
Module exports handleWebhook and fulfills a valid event

scope: Verified for these synthetic conditions in this sandbox. Not a production guarantee.
